observations: The page number «60» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L02: the heading of chapter 17, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it; L02: «27–56», a short dash (25 px) with a gap of 14 px before it and 9 px after it, as «45–46» on p. 42 (JP2 0074, N06); transcribed as an en dash.

L03-L04: the Latin heading of chapter 17, «De latitudine trium superiorum planetarum» (p. 14, JP2 0046), names only the three upper planets; the chapter treats the two lower ones in its second paragraph, which is why Suter calls the title incorrect. L05: «(13. Buch)», Almagest XIII.

L16: the full stop after «ist» is printed at mid-height (7 × 8 px, 9-17 px above the base line), where the points of the page stand on it; see the critical note. L37: a light mark at mid-height after «des», smaller and fainter than a point (5 × 5 px); not transcribed.

N01: both dashes long, «115—116» faint; N02: the dash of «247—255» printed in two faint pieces (15 and 10 px); each transcribed as one long dash. N03: «Burgess» is not spaced here, where it is spaced in other notes (p. 59, JP2 0091, N01). Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Ptol.», «Batt.», «Nallino», «Delambre», «Nallinos», «Kh.»; italics: «drei obern», «zwei untern», «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Transl.», «Journal of the American Orient. Soc.».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-14 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the sentence ends after «abhängig ist», and «Die Breite» begins the next one; the full stop is printed at mid-height instead of on the base line
